name: KSW MCU (F2 00): any car (raw messages)
description: The KSW MCU of the Android screens of BMW, Mercedes-Benz…: no CAN box of its own, the MCU decodes the car and sends the values in its own frames F2 00 CMD LEN data SUM, SUM = (CMD + LEN + data) XOR FF, 115200 bit/s; the MCU profile ksw-px6 of LibreHU service (v194 and later) copies them to the car data engine (CAN link « through the MCU »). No acknowledgement. From VincentZ4's « KSW API – Commands » v2.12 (BMW F1x 2011-2012 CIC 8.8/10.25 in, PX6, Android 9) and McuCommunicator (github.com/KswCarProject/McuCommunicator, GPL-3.0; values only). Any car: no decoding, raw messages. Also the description of this box type ("box": "ksw-mcu").
